headline: Weathered Expanse Flares as Shelf, Row Stir
war_summary: Since the 06:11 edition the wires have quickened, with Weathered Expanse furnishing 13 changes in the last two hours and 62 on the day to 09:22 about Crow's Nest, Frostmarch and Wightwalk, holdings now four Warden, three Colonial and two destroyed with day losses of 8,603 Colonial and 14,062 Warden. Stlican Shelf follows with two changes in two hours and 23 on the day to 08:35 about Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost, holdings three Warden, five Colonial and one destroyed. Fisherman's Row adds one change in two hours and 33 on the day to 07:44 about Eidolo, Black Well and Dankana Post, holdings three Warden and six Colonial. Nevish Line shows one change in two hours and five on the day to 07:34 about Grief Mother, holdings eight Warden. Callahan's Passage and Mooring County have gone quiet since then, with no changes in two hours after 29 and 12 on the day to 02:43 and 03:56.
